scope: Existing depth-16 production input, before any proposed credit-based interface. These two simulations compare ACK sampling epochs against the same physical key schedule.

replay.source: Compile this fixture and rtl/shama_input.sv with iverilog -g2012 and run vvp.
replay.mapped: Use the production JSON-to-Verilog generation in tests/test_input_mapped_snapshots.py. Compile this fixture with that mapped.v and -DSHAMA_INPUT_MAPPED, then run vvp.

stimulus: Reset, queue sixteen individually released A keys, sample a B key and an exact A ACK. A second identical FIFO receives the ACK one rising edge later.
implication: A new request/accept protocol needs real producer-side credit or durable reservation of the original ACK epoch. Delaying an already-sampled ACK changes observable queue state.
